title: Rodak HTTP response envelope
description: Every JSON /api/v1 response (http-api.ts:77-88). Business errors keep HTTP 200 and put the error in `code` with data null. Exception: access-token pre-handler failures are HTTP 401 + code 401 (http-api.ts:398-420). A success data may be null where a route says so (HTTP shadow report). Appearance routes (/api/v1/aiot/appearance/*) are the exception: they set the HTTP status to the business code (appearance-http-api.ts:17-21).
